headlines.title: The Bay Area's PWHL expansion team has a name: San Jose Sea Lions
headlines.description: A girl was killed and four other people were injured in a two-vehicle collision in San Jose Sunday evening. Shortly before 5:45 p.m., a 2001 black Acura sedan that was headed east on Tully Road near White Road crossed the center median and ended up in the westbound lanes of Tully Road, San Jose police said in a news release Monday. The Acura, driven by a teen girl who had a juvenile girl in the car with her as a passenger, collided with a 2022 blue Tesla sedan. The Acura’s passenger died at the scene and the driver was taken to the hospital with life-threatening injuries but has been stabilized, police officials said. The occupants of the Tesla, two men and a woman, were all taken to the hospital to be treated for injuries that aren’t considered life-threatening. The Acura passenger’s name wasn’t released Monday and police didn’t say what might have led to the collision. It was San Jose 43rd traffic-related death of 2026. Anyone with information can contact Detective DelliCarpini of the San Jose Police Department’s Traffic Investigations Unit at 4103@sanjoseca.gov or 408-277-4654.
